head.title: spaCR: spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 screens
head.description: spaCR {{SPACR_VERSION}}: segmentation, single-cell measurement, classification, barcode mapping and regression for image-based pooled CRISPR screens. Pipeline, published models, screen results, papers and installation.
tabs.label: spaCR sections
overview.lede: Spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 screens.
overview.prose: spaCR segments cells, nuclei and pathogens in microscopy images, measures every object, and links the measurements to the guide RNAs sequenced from the same wells. It starts from plate images and FASTQ reads and ends with per-cell measurements, trained classifiers and a ranked list of genes.
overview.figure.alt: Hoechst image of infected HeLa cells with nuclei outlined in blue, host cells in cyan and Toxoplasma vacuoles in magenta
overview.figure.caption: One Hoechst image, three object classes: nuclei (blue), host cells (cyan) and Toxoplasma vacuoles (magenta). Host cells and vacuoles are predicted from the Hoechst channel alone. See Models.

models.title: Published models
models.intro: Each figure shows one real image and the objects that spaCR's published models detect in it. Drag the divider to compare the input with the outlines, and use the check boxes to show or hide a class. Counts are objects in the image shown. {{SHOWCASE_SPACR}}.

screen.title: Screen results
screen.intro: A pooled CRISPR screen in Toxoplasma gondii for parasite genes that affect recruitment of the host ESCRT protein GFP-TSG101 to the parasite vacuole, analysed with spaCR. From the spaCR preprint.
screen.volcano.alt: Two volcano plots of gene effect against significance; EAF1 and GRA14 lie above the threshold in both
screen.volcano.caption: Gene effects from a measurement classifier (XGBoost, left) and an image classifier (MaxViT, right); EAF1 and GRA14 pass 3σ in both. Preprint Fig. 5.
screen.hit.alt: Volcano plot with SAG1 and GRA14 above the significance line
screen.hit.caption: Regression on one plate (30 wells): the controls GRA14 (q 0.040) and SAG1 (q 0.006) pass q < 0.05. Data: spacr-example-hit.
screen.gene.alt: Interactive volcano plot in the Regression module with one gene selected and its gene card below
screen.gene.caption: Regression module: clicking a point opens the gene card, here EAF1 (TGGT1_225160).

phenotypes.title: Phenotypes
phenotypes.intro: Every measured cell can be placed on a two-dimensional map with its image crop, so that groups of similar cells can be found and checked by eye.
phenotypes.umap.alt: UMAP of 5,000 cells with five outlined clusters and four example crops per cluster
phenotypes.umap.caption: Image UMAP of 5,000 cells from screen plate 1: five HDBSCAN clusters that differ in nuclei and vacuoles per cell; crops are cells near each cluster centre.
phenotypes.crops.alt: Measure module showing a grid of single-cell crops
phenotypes.crops.caption: Object crops saved by Measure from a sixteen-field run.

phenotypes.field.caption: One recruitment-assay field: channels, then cell, nucleus and parasite masks.
assays.title: Assays and QC
assays.intro: Outputs of spaCR's assay and quality-control modules on its public example data sets, computed on CPU.
assays.dose.alt: Dose-response curves of median cell count for five compounds, SNX-2112 highlighted with its EC50
assays.dose.caption: Dose-Response: four-parameter logistic fits for the 5 of 58 compounds with a bounded EC50; SNX-2112 EC50 0.299 µM (95% CI 0.279–0.319). Data: spacr-example-dose, 1,536 wells, 4 plates.
assays.control.alt: Control chart of DMSO-well median cell count across 24 plates with control limits and flagged plates
assays.control.caption: Control chart: DMSO-well median cell count across 24 plates; all 24 fall outside the limits after cell-line, time-point and seeding changes. Data: spacr-example-control-chart.
assays.plaque.alt: Crystal-violet plaque well with 99 plaques outlined in magenta
assays.plaque.caption: Plaque Assay: 99 plaques found by toxoplasma_plaque_v3 in a well from Cabral et al. 2024 (CC BY 4.0); 98 in the hand-drawn mask.
assays.recruitment.alt: Bar plots of GFP-TSG101 recruitment for negative and positive control wells on four plates
assays.recruitment.caption: Recruitment: GFP-TSG101 vacuole-to-cytoplasm ratio in SAG1 (negative) and GRA14 (positive) control wells on four plates; plate means p = 8.4 × 10⁻⁵.
